note: Prompts for checking the skill by hand or with the skill-creator workflow. Subjects are generic; do not treat any number in a prompt as fact.

evals.name: new-article-fault-code
evals.prompt: یه مقاله سئو شده بنویس درباره چراغ ای‌بی‌اس روشن شد. سایت ما تعمیرگاه خودروهای ایرانی توی شیراز هست. تجربه یا آمار خاصی ندارم که بدم.
evals.expected_output: Mode A. Research block first; H1 + H2 tree following problem→causes→diagnosis→when to stop; standalone answers under headings; no invented prices/stats/experience; safety branch stated; CTA after value with only user-supplied contact; HTML file delivered; linter run; Rank Math package; schema = Article + BreadcrumbList (+LocalBusiness), FAQ markup described as optional with no rich result.
checks: No claim like 'in our workshop we always see' appears
No price range or statistic without a source
Exactly one H1; file delivered as .html
Final check lists items needing the owner's confirmation
Does not promise FAQ/HowTo rich results

evals.name: ctr-fix-with-gsc-export
evals.prompt: این مقاله ایمپرشن بالایی داره ولی کلیک نداره. خروجی سرچ کنسول (کوئری‌ها) و لینک مقاله رو دادم. فقط عنوان و متا رو درست کن، بقیه رو دست نزن.
evals.expected_output: Mode B-lite. analyze_gsc.py run on the CSV; diagnosis of which queries underperform vs the file's own baseline; 3 title and 3 meta options in query wording; H1/URL left unchanged; note to verify the live SERP and re-measure after 3-4 weeks; no full rewrite.
checks: Script output used rather than eyeballed numbers
URL and body untouched, stated explicitly
Options are natural, no clickbait, lengths within rule of thumb
States what the data cannot show

evals.name: geo-promise-pushback
evals.prompt: می‌خوام مقاله‌م حتماً توی جواب‌های چت‌جی‌پی‌تی و AI Overview بیاد. FAQ schema و llms.txt هم بزن که تضمینی بشه.
evals.expected_output: Does not promise citations. Explains that Google says AI features are still SEO, no special schema or llms.txt needed, FAQ rich results removed May 2026; other engines undocumented. Offers what does help (original content, standalone answers, crawlability, sourcing) and how to measure. Still helps with the article.
checks: No guarantee language
Correct statement of FAQ/HowTo status
Says other engines' behaviour is not documented/verified
Still delivers concrete next steps

evals.name: rewrite-ai-sounding-post
evals.prompt: این مقاله رو از وردپرس کپی کردم. خیلی رباتیکه و می‌گن «در دنیای امروز» زیاد داره. بازنویسیش کن ولی آدرس و ساختار اصلی رو نگه دار.
evals.expected_output: Mode B. Intro rewritten problem-first; clichés removed; existing URL/structure preserved; standalone answers added; any 'we always...' claim flagged or removed unless supplied; linter before/after; Persian typography fixed.
checks: Linter errors fixed (ي/ك, ZWNJ, generic openers)
Structure and URL preserved as requested
Lists what was changed and what was deliberately left

evals.name: non-automotive-ymyl
evals.prompt: Write an SEO article in English for a dental clinic site: 'does a loose crown need an emergency visit?'
evals.expected_output: Mode A in English. Safety-first answer, red-flag symptoms, honest limits of remote advice, no dosing or DIY procedures beyond safe interim care from reputable sources, reviewer placeholder [TO CONFIRM], sources from dental associations/health authorities, no invented clinic data, no fake credentials.
checks: Reviewer/author left as [TO CONFIRM], not invented
Sources are reputable and opened
Urgent red flags appear before general advice
No invented prices or success rates
